response.text: CLOSE_DT is a real NULL. Now the period, close, and invoice-vs-GL tests.

arguments.sql:
select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD",
 case when h."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" then 'out_of_period' else '' end a,
 case when p."CLOSE_DT" is not null and h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT" then 'after_close' else '' end b,
 case when p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."JRNL_NO">2400 then 'late' else '' end c
from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID"
where h."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" or (p."CLOSE_DT" is not null and h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT") or (p."STAT_CD"='O' and p."CLOSE_DT" is not null)

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", i."STAT_CD", g.dr, g.cr, g.ap_cr, g.exp_dr from "APINVH" i left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr, sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")='2000' then "CR_AMT"-"DR_AMT" else 0 end) ap_cr, sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")<>'2000' then "DR_AMT"-"CR_AMT" else 0 end) exp_dr from "GLJRNL" group by "JRNL_NO") g on g."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where g.ap_cr<>i."INV_AMT" or g.exp_dr<>i."INV_AMT" or g.dr is null

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", g.dr2000, g.cr1000, h."JRNL_NO" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" left join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")='2000' then "DR_AMT" else 0 end) dr2000, sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")='1000' then "CR_AMT" else 0 end) cr1000 from "GLJRNL" group by 1) g on g."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" where p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" or g.dr2000<>p."PAY_AMT" or g.cr1000<>p."PAY_AMT" or g.dr2000 is null
